_comment: #1596: parse extracted literal module argv with the real CLI builder, never execute handlers.
The invented-flag fixture stays bad after --generate-makefile becomes real. The repaired form is separately proven clean.
Helper scope is statically referenced source; dynamic module assembly is not executed. Named unsupported shapes and insufficient population fail.
